newsitem.title: USA: A.H. Belo Q3 shr rises to $0.42.
newsitem.headline: A.H. Belo Q3 shr rises to $0.42.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTE: 1995 includes operations of KIRO-TV after Belo bought it Feb 1. 1996 includes operations of the Bryan-College Station Eagle and the Owensboro Messenger-Inquirer newspapers, which Belo bought in December 1995 and January 1996.

Nine-month net for 1996 includes a first-quarter gain of $3,895,000, or $0.06 a share, on sale of Belo's interest in its programming distribution partnership. Nine-month period for 1995 includes a second-quarter gain of $2,406,000 on the sale of Belo's investment in Stauffer Communications Inc stock.
Average shares for 1996 periods include effect of 5,750,000 shares Series A common issued in May.
